blurb: Guests rent Yamaha VX jet skis to explore scenic waterways around Jacksonville, including protected zones and city landmarks. They must have a valid Florida boating license or temporary certificate to operate. The business offers add-ons like waterproof phone cases, GoPro rentals, and a loyalty rewards program.
extraNote: Cancellations require 48 hours’ notice for refund; within 48 hours non-refundable but voucher issued · Rescheduling allowed up to 24 hours before scheduled ride via customer portal · No walk-ups accepted; booking must be online or by phone at least 2 hours before ride · Failure to provide proper boating license results in no operation and possible cancellation policy enforcement · Arlington Lions Club Park pavilion near the boat ramp
